sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior applicability implication, the approved-only status checks, certification maxCount 1, ship-to-dischargeDistanceRecords path, both nautical-mile distance operands, and no numerical minimum. Repair the distance-record coverage: the ship constraint currently passes when any linked node exists, while the record constraint runs only for nodes explicitly typed nltl:dischargeDistanceRecords, so an untyped or incorrectly typed linked node can bypass the required distance checks. Ensure every node reached by nltl:hasDischargeDistanceRecord for an applicable ship is validated for both required quantity properties and units, either by validating linked nodes directly from the ship constraint or by requiring the relationship target to have the dischargeDistanceRecords type before relying on the class-targeted shape.
